parsedVerdict.reasoning: CatalogueService does the usual work of an application-layer use-case service. It coordinates the domain repository port and the Product entity, and maps domain objects to DTOs. It contains no persistence code: no SQL, ORM or storage calls, because it goes through the injected ProductRepository interface. It contains no transport or framework logic either: no HTTP, request/response handling or framework decorators. The duplicate-id check in addProduct uses the repository to enforce uniqueness, which is normally treated as use-case coordination in the application layer. Product creation, and any rules about the product's own state, are left to the Product constructor in the domain layer. The private toDto method maps between domain objects and application DTOs, which also belongs in the application layer.
